what: the year-0 plant of both reference villages, on bare ground and as an extension of the plant already standing
held_fixed: one instance per village: reference year 2025, central trajectory, twelve months of connection maturity, the project's own network loss. Only the standing plant differs between the two rows of a pair, so the difference is the plant's and not the demand's. A plan decided today would use each village's real maturity, thirty-three months at Samionta and twenty-five at Gbowele, which is a separate run.
reproduces: the two greenfield rows reproduce summary_certification_samionta_central_mixed_m12_voll1.json and summary_certification_gbowele_central_mixed_m12_voll1.json to the last digit, the standing plant being empty by default
gap_note: gap_rel_pct is (z_rule - z_opt) / z_rule in per cent, and every case is proven over its lattice: the gap is the price of the heuristic controller, not an unfinished search
standing_plant_note: standing_plant_usd_yr is what the plant already there still owes each year, its maintenance plus the replacement its remaining service life defers. It is a constant of the design
